description: Deterministic exit gates for the ten-stage pipeline. A FAIL blocks advancement unless the human explicitly records a --force override.

G0-scope.check: RQ, venue, language, constraints and data-access level recorded

G1-falsifiability.check: Rival hypotheses + discriminating predictions frozen before analysis

G2-reproducible-search.check: Every query logged with database, string, filters, date and hit count

G3-screening.check: Dual decisions, adjudication, ordered exclusion codes, kappa, PRISMA counts

G4-claims.check: Every claim bound to at least one evidence row; no dangling ids; no overclaims

G5-draft.check: IMRaD complete, no placeholders, every figure/table referenced

G6-integrity-1.check: References resolve or are explicitly unverified; style score >= 70; no placeholders

G7-review.check: Methodological, statistical and adversarial critiques recorded with location anchors

G8-revision.check: Every reviewer comment has a response, action and manuscript location

G9-final.check: All gates pass; venue rules re-verified; disclosures, data/code availability, CRediT, AI-use statements complete

audit_limits: Gates examine the manuscript and its reported process, not the physical world.
A consistently reported fabrication can pass these checks.
Human accountability for data authenticity always rests with the authors.
